limits: The 39 PNG matrix is explicit asset preview, not 39 native battle actors.

Period 4 uses separate legitimate Sun Quan and Liu Shan new games: Sun Quan is in Wu with a friendly neighbour; Zhuge Liang marches from Ba Jun to Wu Ling.
Pang De is absent from the audited period-4 Cao Pi owned queues; no fake ownership or battle was injected.
Unknown sc-mod.lib is genuinely loaded, hashed, started through its normal difficulty/name prompt, and observed in native classic map/city; full Mod battle remains R11.
LCD fallback visibility is computed DOM visibility; it is not full native paint-stack or real mobile acceptance.
No new native C or WASM build, performance benchmark, mobile device or cloud account acceptance is claimed.
